// auth: Entra ID sign-in. Replace <TENANT_ID> with your tenant GUID.
AAD_CLIENT_ID / AAD_CLIENT_SECRET are app settings you set after creating the
app registration — they are never committed.
Planner.Editor / Planner.Viewer are App Roles on that registration; Entra puts
them in the token and SWA surfaces them as userRoles to the API.
// routes: Everything requires sign-in — this is an internal tool with staff names and
rates on it. Write enforcement is NOT done here: the API checks Planner.Editor
itself, so a route misconfiguration cannot grant write access.
